Licence notices of the packages bundled inside jsPDF 4.2.1's minified UMD build, from each
package's own tarball on the npm registry (npm pack, 2026-10-01), whose SHA-512 equalled
npm's published dist.integrity. The build records no version but cssesc's and pako's; each
other notice is that of the newest release in the range the bundling package declares.
